events.description: For nearly two decades, Free Fallin: The Tom Petty Concert Experience has faithfully recreated the sound, spirit, and energy of Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers. Honored to perform at Tom Petty's Birthday Bash in Gainesville, Florida, the band has earned a reputation as one of North America's premier tribute acts.
